scope: DC-biased differential-tensor AC at 100 kHz for a periodic 0.2 mm flex layer and 1 mm Al wall with 0.1 mm gap. Not finite current return paths, arbitrary amplitude/PWM, hysteresis or exterior E/Poynting qualification.
coil_scope: Two isolated 20 micrometre sinusoidal sheets at the PCB faces, not a routed winding
material_provenance: Provisional ideal two-slope model inputs, not measured frequency-dependent material data
refinement_gate: 2% of added reactive/resistive factor and loss, with fixed 0.001 real / 1e-5 imaginary absolute floors
comparison_gate: 5% of added reactive/resistive factor and loss, with the same absolute floors
